combo_label: School Days × Cycling × The Wild West

entries.clue: Looped rope a rider whirls overhead to catch a running calf
Swing-door drinking den with a piano and a card game in the corner
Cowboy's broad-brimmed felt hat, the maker's surname now the word for it
Bag slung beside a rear rack for carrying the shopping home
Robber on the run whose likeness is pinned up around town
Staying behind after the bell to write lines you will never read again
Lidded table with an inkwell hole and carved initials
Slim wire running from a wheel's middle out to its edge
Thirty-centimetre strip for straight edges and knuckle taps
Ordeal in a silent hall where papers are turned over at a signal
Greasy loop of links that carries your effort to the back wheel
